name: scene-maun
title: Maun
description: A colour field that paints itself in thin veils, rolled on and scraped back so a warm ground glows through, then rests with only a slow breath of light. Four palettes (turmeric, monsoon, kokum, indigo on lime); the same seed is always the same painting. A quiet background for words and a document cover; in playful, a click scrapes a band back. After V. S. Gaitonde's method, not his pictures.
